title: AgentHarnessSpec
description: The fields of an agent harness that an administrator edits. A draft holds one, `PUT /v1/agentHarness/{id}/draft` takes one whole, and publishing copies it into the harness. On a persona harness it holds only the persona's own settings, never the items inherited from the default.

context.description: Knowledge rules, persona prompt, character budget and cache lifetime. The definition's own `enabled` flag must stay true, because the harness's `enabled` decides. Its read-only cache fields are ignored.

companyInstructions.description: Instructions every agent receives. Only on the default harness.

perTurnTokenBudget.description: Most tokens delivered across the events of one turn. At least the sum of the enabled events' budgets.

events.description: Delivery settings per hook event. The default lists every event. A persona harness lists only the events it adds or whose budget it lowers.

skills.description: Skills offered to agents. A persona harness lists only the skills it adds.

guardrails.description: Guardrail levels. A persona harness lists only the guardrails it makes stricter.

toolAccess.description: Which MCP servers and tools agents may call. A persona harness can only make the default's decisions stricter.

memory.description: Agent memory settings. Absent on a persona harness that uses the default's.

knowledgeGraph.description: How agents use the knowledge_graph tool. Absent on a persona harness that uses the default's.

answerHarness.description: How `finish_answer` writes its citation block. Only on the default harness.
